assessment.population: Adults with and without high blood pressure
assessment.plain: Drops after sessions in short studies.
assessment.summary: Short studies show blood pressure drops after sauna sessions.
assessment.rationale: Illustrative grade for design review only. Not assessed against the rubric.
assessment.limitations: A biomarker, not a health outcome. Mostly short-term effects measured right after sessions.

updates.summary: Illustrative starting grade: very low confidence. Sample content, not a reviewed assessment.
updates.whyItMatters: Sets the starting point that later changes are measured against.
updates.reasoning: Design fixture. No reviewer has assessed this claim.

updates.summary: Illustrative: a second controlled trial with repeated sessions over several weeks. Still a biomarker result, not proof of fewer heart events.
updates.whyItMatters: Repeated sessions over weeks are closer to real use than single sessions, so confidence in the blood pressure effect rises a step.
updates.reasoning: Design fixture. No reviewer has assessed this change.
